matches.title: Monza vs Avellino
matches.description: Watch Monza vs Avellino highlights and goals from Coppa Italia on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 14, 2026. The Coppa Italia returned to action on August 14, 2026, as Monza hosted Avellino in a knockout tie filled with high expectations. Both sides looked to make an early statement in the competition, setting the stage for a tactical battle under the lights. Varela’s First-Half Masterclass Monza established their dominance from the opening whistle, pinning Avellino back with relentless attacking sequences. The creative hub of Patrick Cutrone and Omari Forson was at the heart of everything, constantly probing a stretched defensive line. After several near-misses and desperate blocks from the visitors, the deadlock was finally broken in the 22nd minute. Gustavo Varela showcased his clinical instincts, finding the bottom left corner with a sharp left-footed strike from the center of the box to give the hosts a deserved lead. Avellino struggled to find an answer to Monza ’s fluid movement. Just as the first half seemed to be drawing to a close, the home side struck again to double their cushion. In the 45th minute, Patrick Cutrone turned provider, delivering a precise ball to Gustavo Varela , who calmly slotted home his second goal of the match into the bottom right corner. The brace from the young attacker sent Monza into the break with a commanding two-goal advantage and all the momentum. Forson Seals the Deal There was no let-up from the hosts as the second half commenced. Within six minutes of the restart, the match was effectively put to bed. Patrick Cutrone , continuing his exceptional display of playmaking, threaded a perfect through ball to Omari Forson . The winger made no mistake, firing a left-footed shot into the top right corner to make it 3-0. The goal allowed Monza to manage the game, leading to a flurry of substitutions including the introduction of Andrea Colpani and Andrea Petagna . Despite the deficit, Avellino showed glimpses of fight. Luca Pandolfi and Andrea Favilli both tested the Monza backline, with goalkeeper Demba Thiam called into action to preserve his clean sheet. Avellino 's frustration began to show late on, as Dimitrios Sounas received a yellow card for a heavy challenge in stoppage time. Professional Finish to the Tie In the dying moments, Andrea Colpani nearly added a fourth with a curling free-kick that whistled just over the crossbar. However, the work had already been done. The final whistle confirmed a comprehensive 3-0 victory for Monza , a result built on the predatory finishing of Gustavo Varela and the sublime vision of Patrick Cutrone , who ended the match with three assists. For Avellino , it was a difficult exit from the tournament, while Monza marches on to the next round with confidence.
